reviews.comment: I'm normally pretty good with mathematics, but he often skipped over things and didn't fully explain the solutions to problems were work on in class. A lot of my issues with the class come down to its structure, but I'm not sure if these core classes can be altered by professors based on my last math class. I don't think he's a bad professor.

Best professor I ever had! I love the lecture so much, but I'm not major in Software security so, I did not spend lots of time on it! But, he is a really good professor!! And really nice at grading!!!! Please take his classes!

Maybe it will change in future semesters, but this professor only ended up posting 3 of the 5 assignments for the semester, didn't post all of the lectures, and did not grade assignments for literal months. The class is good for an easy A, but do not go in hoping to learn anything (unfortunately...).

Attendance is basically mandatory as he gives quizzes in class with a password. Expects you to understand topics very deeply as tests question very specific conceptual knowledge, almost like trivia. Projects are weird as he takes MIT labs and combines/modifies them... Also be aware his qdrop rate is VERY high. Tough class, but hes nice guy at least
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class was a disaster. He created the programming assignments throughout the semester, so he could not anticipate any potential problems we would have. Every assignment he gives has a 10 point bonus, but if you do not do the bonus then the best score you can receive is a 90. When the whole class does poorly on something, he says it's our fault.
Very interesting lectures, clears all your doubts, gives take-home exams that are challenging but fun to work on, and grading criteria is the best that I have seen.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures
